item.title: Saudi Arabia Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in Saudi Arabia on Thursday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: USD/CHF tumbles to near 0.7650 amid US trade policy uncertainty, Fed independence concerns
item.description: The USD/CHF pair attracts some sellers to around 0.7650 during the early European session on Thursday.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Extends rally to fresh high since February 2023, near 0.7100
item.description: The AUD/USD pair extends its strong uptrend witnessed over the past two weeks or so and jumps to a fresh high since February 2023, closer to the 0.7100 mark, during the Asian session on Thursday.

item.title: Pound Sterling Price News: GBP/USD rises toward 1.3869, the highest since September 2021
item.description: GBP/USD recovers its recent losses from the previous session, trading around 1.3830 during the Asian hours on Thursday. The technical analysis of the daily chart points to a potential bearish reversal as the range narrows, indicating waning buyer momentum within a rising wedge pattern.

item.title: EUR/JPY climbs toward 183.50 despite Japanese intervention risks
item.description: EUR/JPY has recovered its recent losses from the previous session, trading around 183.40 during the Asian hours on Thursday.

item.title: Japanese Yen bulls seem hesitant as fiscal woes and political uncertainty offset hawkish BoJ
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) remains on the front foot against a weaker US Dollar (USD) through the Asian session on Thursday, though it lacks bullish conviction amid mixed fundamental cues.

item.title: Indian Rupee receives as traders expect RBI intervention
item.description: USD/INR depreciates after registering more than 0.5% gains in the previous session. The Indian Rupee (INR) gains ground amid speculation of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervention, aiming to curb losses as the pair touched a fresh all-time high of 92.19 on January 28.

item.title: Gold buying remains unabated as safe-haven flows continue to fuel record-breaking rally
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) prolongs its record-setting rally for the ninth straight day and advances over 3% on Thursday, climbing to the $5,600 neighborhood during the Asian session.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Keeps bullish vibe near 108.50 amid Japan's fiscal and political challenges
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross extends the rally to near 108.50 during the early European session on Thursday. Concerns over fiscal health and political uncertainty in Japan weigh on the Japanese Yen (JPY) against the Australian Dollar (AUD).

item.title: EUR/USD: Range trading expected – UOB Group
item.description: EUR/USD is anticipated to trade within a range of 1.1920 to 1.2020 following a sharp pullback. The recent price movements indicate a potential range-trading phase after EUR dropped to a low of 1.1895 and closed at 1.1952, report UOB Group analysts Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann.
